gizmo.title: Wasan gudun ra'ayoyi
gizmo.description: Wasan gungurawa a gefe. Halittar tana gudu da wuta kuma ba ta tsayawa. Yi tsalle don ɗaukar ra'ayoyi masu kyau da tsallake marasa kyau, sannan ka ga taƙaitaccen abin da ya kyau da wanda bai kyau ba.

configure.title: Ra'ayoyi
configure.description: Ana ɗaukar masu kyau, ana tsallake marasa kyau.

configure.title: Tsawon gudu da daƙiƙa
configure.description: Kusan tsawon lokacin da gudun yake ɗauka da saurin da aka saba.

configure.title: Bayan wasa
configure.description: Zaɓi ne. Yana maye gurbin akwatin kwafar umarni a allon ƙarshe da naka abun cikin, kamar mataki na gaba ko hanyar haɗi.

configure.title: Ƙarin maɓallai bayan wasa
configure.description: Zaɓi ne. Maɓallai ko hanyoyin haɗi da ake nunawa kusa da Sake wasa a allon ƙarshe.

advanced.title: Iri na halitta
advanced.description: Kowane rubutu. Iri ɗaya yana haifar da halitta ɗaya koyaushe. Wannan iri ɗaya ne da avatar na HAX yake amfani da shi.

advanced.title: Yi amfani da halittar mutumin da ya shiga
advanced.description: Idan wani ya shiga HAX, halittar tana kama da avatar ɗinsa. Sauran mutane suna ganin irin da ke sama.

advanced.title: Makin cin nasara
advanced.description: Lamba daga 0 zuwa 1. Ana aika shi tare da abin da ya kammala ci gaba a matsayin iyakar nasara.

advanced.title: Sunan wasa
advanced.description: Yana sanya wa wannan wasan suna a abubuwan ci gaba da alamar OER Schema.

advanced.title: ID na wasa
advanced.description: Zaɓi ne. Yana bambanta wannan wasan da sauran a shafin cikin abubuwan ci gaba.
